A world of possibilities. Stir, drag, or hold empty space to pour.15 places to play. Tap, then drag or tap a new spot.

Move your pointer through the stickers to stir them. Drag and release to throw. Use arrow keys to move a focused sticker, and hold Shift for a larger step. Press Escape to return it to the pile. You can also tap or click a sticker, then tap or click empty space to move it without dragging. Scroll from empty space, or an unselected sticker on touch. Use Reset the world to arrange all 15 places again.
